name: Age Differences In Marriage
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred union of marriage as a man leaving his parents to become one flesh with his wife, highlighting commitment beyond external factors such as age or wealth (Genesis 2:24; Ruth 3:10). The Bible recognizes that age differences exist, as seen in Abraham and Sarah's advanced years, yet God's blessing and purpose transcend these circumstances (Genesis 17:17). Faithful kindness and rejoicing in the spouse of one's youth are valued over superficial attraction, encouraging a heart focused on enduring love rather than fleeting beauty (Proverbs 5:18; Proverbs 6:25).
